asked.text:
When someone posts feedback that includes a URL, show a nice link
preview (title, description, image) so the board doesn't look like a
wall of raw links.

understood.text: I'm building a link preview module that uses cheerio to extract Open Graph tags, plus a regex for pulling URLs out of text, in lib/link-preview.ts.
